1-buscando.title: Rise and Grind
1-buscando.tags: Future house electro-pop, clean modern mix with crisp transients and polished low end, bright plucky synth hooks over a punchy four-on-the-floor kick, instrumental, 124 BPM driving pulse with a short tense intro, quick riser build, and big euphoric drop.

2-manifiesto.title: Night Drift
2-manifiesto.tags: Drift phonk, 130 BPM driving trap pulse; aggressive punchy intro with no slow build, gritty saturated mix; sharp cowbell melody over heavy distorted 808 bass and hard-hitting trap drums.

3-despegue-a.title: The Ticking Overture
3-despegue-a.tags: Cinematic trailer, hybrid orchestral and synth, instrumental; ticking clock pulse beneath a rising string-and-synth ostinato, deep braams, a huge impact hit, then a soaring triumphant orchestral theme. Driving 100 BPM, inspiring and epic, with cinematic layering and a wide, polished mix.

3-despegue-b.title: The Ticking Overture
3-despegue-b.tags: Cinematic trailer, driving 100 BPM pulse; polished cinematic mix with rising tension, ticking clock rhythm and swelling ostinato; deep braams, hybrid orchestral and synth layers, a massive impact hit into a soaring triumphant theme.

4-pov.title: Cozy Afternoon
4-pov.tags: Lo-fi hip hop, instrumental; warm Rhodes piano chords over soft boom bap drums, mellow bass and vinyl crackle; gentle tape saturation; relaxed 85 BPM groove.

5-trabajo.title: Latin Funk Groove
5-trabajo.tags: Nu-disco, buoyant 118 BPM groove with a tight disco drum mix, slap bass locked to the kick, crisp congas and shaker, clipped wah guitar, and bright brass stabs.

6-rebrand.title: Cold to Warm
6-rebrand.tags: Ambient electronic, spare felt piano over airy electronic textures, gradually unfolding into warm pulsing synths and light percussion; stereo field slowly widens, polished cinematic mix; 90 BPM, steady unhurried pulse; instrumental.

7-notis.title: Playful Plucks
7-notis.tags: Minimal deep house, smooth 120 BPM groove, subtle tape saturation, crisp hi-hats, rubbery bass and playful plucks, tightly looped arrangement, instrumental
